CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.abuse_effective_rules_v1(p_budget text, p_unit bigint, p_org bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('revision',v.revision,'rules',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)||jsonb_build_object(
 'base_limit',coalesce(u.base_limit,o.base_limit,r.base_limit)) ORDER BY r.rule_key),'[]'::jsonb))
 FROM public.abuse_policy_revision v CROSS JOIN public.abuse_policy_rules r
 LEFT JOIN public.abuse_policy_overrides o ON o.rule_key=r.rule_key AND o.target_kind='organization'
  AND o.target_id=p_org AND r.scope_kind IN ('unit','organization') AND o.expires_at>statement_timestamp()
 LEFT JOIN public.abuse_policy_overrides u ON u.rule_key=r.rule_key AND u.target_kind='unit'
  AND u.target_id=p_unit AND r.scope_kind='unit' AND u.expires_at>statement_timestamp()
 WHERE r.budget_key=p_budget GROUP BY v.revision
 HAVING count(*)=CASE p_budget WHEN 'occasion.creation' THEN 8 WHEN 'occasion.copy' THEN 2 WHEN 'occasion.draft' THEN 7
  WHEN 'unit.creation' THEN 3 WHEN 'email.ordinary' THEN 4 WHEN 'email.auth' THEN 4
  WHEN 'email.backlog' THEN 4 WHEN 'email.auth.backlog' THEN 1 WHEN 'email.payload' THEN 1
  WHEN 'email.prepare' THEN 2 WHEN 'email.actor' THEN 1 WHEN 'email.dispatch' THEN 1 WHEN 'ticket.document' THEN 4 WHEN 'ticket.preview' THEN 4 WHEN 'bank.operation' THEN 3 WHEN 'order.creation' THEN 4 WHEN 'qr.global' THEN 1 WHEN 'qr.proof' THEN 1 WHEN 'qr.payload' THEN 1 WHEN 'spot.hold' THEN 3 WHEN 'image.upload' THEN 5 WHEN 'image.fetch' THEN 5 WHEN 'sync.snapshot' THEN 2 WHEN 'sync.work' THEN 1 WHEN 'hold.duration' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.reset.source' THEN 2 WHEN 'organization.creation' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.reset.account' THEN 1
  WHEN 'auth.google.source' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.google.client' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.google.global' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.google.attempt' THEN 1 WHEN 'auth.google.proof' THEN 1
  WHEN 'scan.operation' THEN 2 WHEN 'scan.invalid.global' THEN 1 WHEN 'scan.invalid.source' THEN 1 WHEN 'scan.password' THEN 2 WHEN 'scan.export' THEN 2
  WHEN 'reception.create' THEN 1 WHEN 'reception.issue' THEN 1 WHEN 'reception.revoke' THEN 1 WHEN 'reception.cancel' THEN 1
  WHEN 'order.mutation' THEN 4
  WHEN 'push.delivery' THEN 10
  WHEN 'cleaning.report' THEN 3
  WHEN 'push.dispatch' THEN 2
  WHEN 'image.records' THEN 9 WHEN 'auth.password' THEN 2 WHEN 'document.output' THEN 4 WHEN 'image.storage' THEN 3 WHEN 'monitor.thresholds' THEN 6 WHEN 'auth.password.change' THEN 3
  WHEN 'email.send.ordinary' THEN 2 WHEN 'email.send.auth' THEN 2 WHEN 'email.send.commitment' THEN 2
  ELSE -1 END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.abuse_health_internal_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE queues jsonb; expired_at timestamptz; evidence_at timestamptz; capacity jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT jsonb_object_agg(class,stats) INTO queues FROM (
  SELECT class,jsonb_build_object(
   'pendingCount',least(5000,(SELECT count(*) FROM (
     SELECT 1 FROM public.email_messages WHERE admission_class=class
      AND workflow_state IN ('pending','blocked','preparing','sending','retry_wait','unknown') LIMIT 5001
    ) q)),
   'countCappedAt',5000,
   'oldestCreatedAt',(SELECT created_at FROM public.email_messages WHERE admission_class=class
     AND workflow_state IN ('pending','blocked','preparing','sending','retry_wait','unknown') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1),
   -- Historical uncertain sends and future schedules remain visible in counts,
   -- but only runnable work can age into a stalled-delivery alert.
   'oldestDueAt',(SELECT min(greatest(created_at,target_time)) FROM public.email_messages WHERE admission_class=class
     AND workflow_state IN ('pending','preparing','sending','retry_wait') AND target_time<=statement_timestamp())
  ) stats FROM unnest(ARRAY['ordinary','auth','commitment']) class
 ) q;
 SELECT expires_at INTO expired_at FROM public.abuse_budget_usage WHERE expires_at<statement_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 1;
 SELECT measured_at INTO evidence_at FROM public.abuse_unit_evidence ORDER BY measured_at LIMIT 1;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('paused',paused,'quotaMeasuredAt',quota_at,'circuitUntil',circuit_until,
   'nextSendAt',next_send_at,'providerOutageStreak',provider_outage_streak) INTO capacity FROM public.email_capacity LIMIT 1;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('measuredAt',statement_timestamp(),
  'policyRevision',(SELECT revision FROM public.abuse_policy_revision WHERE singleton),
  'queue',queues,'oldestExpiredUsageAt',expired_at,'oldestGrowthEvidenceAt',evidence_at,'provider',capacity);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_payment_reference_scope(p_organization bigint, p_manifest_sha256 text, p_history_reviewed boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE namespace text; namespaces text[];
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.require_service_role();
 IF p_history_reviewed IS DISTINCT FROM true OR p_manifest_sha256 IS NULL OR p_manifest_sha256 !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id=p_organization) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_REFERENCE_ACTIVATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 -- Drain old order writers at their existing form locks before enabling the scope.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.forms f JOIN public.occasions o ON o.id=f.occasion WHERE o.organization=p_organization ORDER BY f.id FOR UPDATE OF f;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.forms f JOIN public.occasions o ON o.id=f.occasion
  JOIN eshop.unit_bank_accounts u ON u.unit=o.unit AND (f.bank_account IS NULL OR f.bank_account=u.bank_account)
  JOIN eshop.bank_accounts b ON b.id=u.bank_account
  LEFT JOIN eshop.payment_reference_accounts a ON a.bank_account_id=b.id
  WHERE o.organization=p_organization AND b.type IS DISTINCT FROM 'CASH' AND NOT public.is_demo_occasion(o.id) AND a.bank_account_id IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_REFERENCE_ACCOUNT_NOT_ENROLLED'; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT a.namespace_id ORDER BY a.namespace_id) INTO namespaces FROM public.forms f JOIN public.occasions o ON o.id=f.occasion
 JOIN eshop.unit_bank_accounts u ON u.unit=o.unit AND (f.bank_account IS NULL OR f.bank_account=u.bank_account)
 JOIN eshop.payment_reference_accounts a ON a.bank_account_id=u.bank_account WHERE o.organization=p_organization AND NOT public.is_demo_occasion(o.id);
 IF namespaces IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_REFERENCE_NO_ENROLLED_DESTINATION'; END IF;
 FOREACH namespace IN ARRAY namespaces LOOP
  PERFORM 1 FROM eshop.payment_reference_namespaces WHERE id=namespace FOR UPDATE;
 END LOOP;
 -- Conservative: all configured destination candidates sharing a physical account
 -- must participate. An unenrolled alias cannot evade the writer inventory.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.forms f JOIN public.occasions o ON o.id=f.occasion
 JOIN eshop.unit_bank_accounts u ON u.unit=o.unit AND (f.bank_account IS NULL OR f.bank_account=u.bank_account)
 JOIN eshop.bank_accounts b ON b.id=u.bank_account JOIN eshop.payment_reference_namespaces n ON n.id=ANY(namespaces)
  AND public.try_payment_reference_account_internal(b.account_number)=n.canonical_account
 WHERE o.organization<>p_organization AND b.type IS DISTINCT FROM 'CASH' AND NOT public.is_demo_occasion(o.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eshop.payment_reference_scopes s WHERE s.organization_id=o.organization AND s.phase='active')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_REFERENCE_UNMIGRATED_SHARED_WRITER'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eshop.payment_info p JOIN eshop.bank_accounts b ON b.id=p.bank_account
 JOIN eshop.payment_reference_namespaces n ON n.id=ANY(namespaces) AND public.try_payment_reference_account_internal(b.account_number)=n.canonical_account
 WHERE p.amount>0 AND p.variable_symbol IS NOT NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eshop.payment_reference_reservations r WHERE r.namespace_id=n.id AND r.variable_symbol=p.variable_symbol AND r.original_payment_info_id=p.id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_REFERENCE_HISTORY_NOT_IMPORTED'; END IF;
 UPDATE eshop.payment_reference_namespaces SET allocation_enabled=true,manifest_sha256=p_manifest_sha256 WHERE id=ANY(namespaces);
 INSERT INTO eshop.payment_reference_scopes(organization_id,phase,manifest_sha256) VALUES(p_organization,'active',p_manifest_sha256)
 ON CONFLICT(organization_id) DO UPDATE SET phase='active',manifest_sha256=excluded.manifest_sha256,updated_at=clock_timestamp();
END $function$

BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_sent_to_customer_flag(history_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE eshop.orders_history
  SET
    -- Coalesce ensures that if data is NULL, it starts with an empty JSON object
    -- before merging. The || operator merges the two JSONB objects.
    data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"is_sent_to_customer": true}'::jsonb
  WHERE
    id = history_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_sync_map(p_source_name text, p_target_org_id bigint, p_target_unit_id bigint, p_remote_link_base text, p_remote_org_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_remote_unit_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Security Check
    IF auth.role() <> 'service_role' AND session_user <> 'postgres' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access Denied: Service role required.';
    END IF;

    -- Soft Duplicate Check (No DB constraint required)
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.external_sync_maps
        WHERE source_name = p_source_name
          AND target_org_id = p_target_org_id
          AND target_unit_id = p_target_unit_id
          AND remote_link_base = p_remote_link_base
          AND remote_org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_remote_org_id
          AND remote_unit_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_remote_unit_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN 'Map already exists (skipped).';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.external_sync_maps 
    (source_name, target_org_id, target_unit_id, remote_link_base, remote_org_id, remote_unit_id)
    VALUES 
    (p_source_name, p_target_org_id, p_target_unit_id, p_remote_link_base, p_remote_org_id, p_remote_unit_id);
    
    RETURN 'Map added.';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_user_to_occasion_internal_v1(oc bigint, usr uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    occasion_open         BOOLEAN;
    user_data             JSONB;
    user_exists           BOOLEAN;
    user_org              BIGINT;
    occasion_org          BIGINT;
    unit_id               BIGINT;

    -- Initialize flags (though SELECT INTO will overwrite these with NULL if no row found)
    unit_is_manager       BOOLEAN := false;
    unit_is_editor        BOOLEAN := false;
    unit_is_editor_view   BOOLEAN := false;

    is_privileged         BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Retrieve the organization, the unit, and the open status of the occasion.
    SELECT organization, unit, is_open
      INTO occasion_org, unit_id, occasion_open
      FROM occasions
     WHERE id = oc;

    -- 2. Get the organization of the user.
    SELECT organization
      INTO user_org
      FROM user_info
     WHERE id = usr;

    -- 3. Ensure the user and the occasion belong to the same organization.
    IF user_org IS DISTINCT FROM occasion_org THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                  'code', 403,
                  'message', 'User does not belong to the same organization as the occasion'
              );
    END IF;

    -- 4. Retrieve the unit-level role information from unit_users.
    SELECT is_manager, is_editor, is_editor_view
      INTO unit_is_manager, unit_is_editor, unit_is_editor_view
      FROM unit_users
     WHERE unit = unit_id AND "user" = usr;

    -- CRITICAL FIX: SELECT INTO sets variables to NULL if no row is found.
    -- We must ensure they are boolean FALSE to satisfy NOT NULL constraints later.
    unit_is_manager     := COALESCE(unit_is_manager, false);
    unit_is_editor      := COALESCE(unit_is_editor, false);
    unit_is_editor_view := COALESCE(unit_is_editor_view, false);

    -- 5. Define is_privileged.
    --    User is privileged if they have specific unit roles OR are an admin on the occasion.
    is_privileged := unit_is_manager
                     OR unit_is_editor
                     OR unit_is_editor_view
                     OR (SELECT get_is_admin_on_occasion(oc));

    -- 6. Permission Check: Closed Occasions.
    --    If the occasion is not open, only privileged users can be added/modified.
    IF NOT occasion_open AND NOT is_privileged THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 403);
    END IF;

    -- 7. Retrieve the user info and build a JSON object merging any existing data.
    SELECT COALESCE(ui.data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                'name', ui.name,
                'surname', ui.surname,
                'sex', ui.sex,
                'email', ui.email_readonly
           )
      INTO user_data
      FROM user_info ui
     WHERE ui.id = usr;

    -- 8. Check if the user already exists in the occasion_users table.
    SELECT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM occasion_users
              WHERE occasion = oc AND "user" = usr
           ) INTO user_exists;

    IF user_exists THEN
        -- Update the existing row with the new data and the unit role flags.
        UPDATE occasion_users
           SET data           = user_data,
               is_manager     = unit_is_manager,
               is_editor      = unit_is_editor,
               is_editor_view = unit_is_editor_view,
               is_editor_order = unit_is_editor,
               is_editor_order_view = unit_is_editor_view
         WHERE occasion = oc AND "user" = usr;
    ELSE
        -- Insert a new row into occasion_users, using the unit-level role flags.
        INSERT INTO occasion_users (
            occasion,
            "user",
            created_at,
            is_editor,
            is_manager,
            is_editor_view,
            is_editor_order,
            is_editor_order_view,
            is_approved,
            is_approver,
            data,
            role
        )
        VALUES (
            oc,
            usr,
            now(),
            unit_is_editor,
            unit_is_manager,
            unit_is_editor_view,
            unit_is_editor,
            unit_is_editor_view,
            FALSE,
            FALSE,
            user_data,
            NULL
        );
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 200);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admit_occasion_copy_v1(p_source bigint, p_unit bigint, p_org bigint, p_policy jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE policy jsonb; cap bigint; items bigint; bytes bigint;
BEGIN
 policy:=coalesce(p_policy,public.abuse_effective_rules_v1('occasion.copy',p_unit,p_org));
 SELECT (x->>'base_limit')::bigint INTO cap FROM jsonb_array_elements(policy->'rules') x WHERE x->>'rule_key'='occasion.copy.items';
 IF cap IS NULL THEN RAISE configuration_limit_exceeded USING MESSAGE='abuse_policy_missing'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(size),0) INTO items,bytes FROM (
  SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) AS size FROM public.occasions t WHERE id=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.email_templates t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.information_hidden t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.information t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.role_info t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.places t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.exclusive_groups t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.events t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.event_groups t WHERE event_parent IN (SELECT id FROM public.events WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.event_roles t WHERE event IN (SELECT id FROM public.events WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.exclusive_events t WHERE event IN (SELECT id FROM public.events WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM eshop.blueprints t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM eshop.product_types t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM eshop.products t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM eshop.spots t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.forms t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.form_fields t WHERE form IN (SELECT id FROM public.forms WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.inventory_pools t WHERE occasion=p_source
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.inventory_contexts t WHERE inventory_pool IN (SELECT id FROM public.inventory_pools WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.resources t WHERE inventory_pool IN (SELECT id FROM public.inventory_pools WHERE occasion=p_source)
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM public.resource_slots t WHERE resource IN (SELECT id FROM public.resources WHERE inventory_pool IN (SELECT id FROM public.inventory_pools WHERE occasion=p_source))
  UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text) FROM eshop.product_inventory_contexts t WHERE product IN (SELECT id FROM eshop.products WHERE occasion=p_source)
  LIMIT cap+1
 ) copied_rows;
 PERFORM public.abuse_charge_v1(policy,jsonb_build_object('unit',p_unit,'organization',p_org),
  jsonb_build_object('occasion.copy.items',items,'occasion.copy.bytes',bytes));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analyze_new_order_spots(p_spot_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_conflicts jsonb;
  v_new_order_items jsonb;
  v_occasion_id BIGINT;
  v_total numeric; v_currency text; v_order_form jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- =======================================================================
  -- 0. VALIDATION & SECURITY
  -- =======================================================================

  -- Handle empty input
  IF p_spot_ids IS NULL OR array_length(p_spot_ids, 1) IS NULL THEN
     RETURN jsonb_build_object('conflicts', '[]'::jsonb, 'new_order_items', '[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;

  -- Get Occasion ID from the first spot
  SELECT occasion INTO v_occasion_id
  FROM eshop.spots
  WHERE id = p_spot_ids[1];

  IF v_occasion_id IS NULL THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Spot ID % not found.', p_spot_ids[1];
  END IF;

  -- Consistency Check: Ensure all selected spots belong to the SAME occasion
  PERFORM 1
  FROM eshop.spots
  WHERE id = ANY(p_spot_ids)
  AND occasion != v_occasion_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'All selected spots must belong to the same occasion.';
  END IF;

  -- Permission Check: User must have "Order View" rights on this occasion
  IF public.get_is_editor_order_view_on_occasion(v_occasion_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied. User does not have view rights for occasion %.', v_occasion_id;
  END IF;

  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM eshop.spots WHERE id=ANY(p_spot_ids) AND occasion=v_occasion_id)<>cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(p_spot_ids) id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BLUEPRINT_SPOT_SCOPE_MISMATCH'; END IF;
  PERFORM public.lock_blueprint_scope_internal(ARRAY[v_occasion_id]);
  PERFORM public.check_blueprint_selection_units_internal(p_spot_ids);

  -- =======================================================================
  -- 1. IDENTIFY CONFLICTS
  -- =======================================================================
  WITH impacted_base AS (
    SELECT
      s.id as spot_id,
      o.id as order_id,
      o.data as order_data,
      o.state as order_state,
      t.id as ticket_id,
      t.ticket_symbol
    FROM eshop.spots s
    JOIN eshop.order_product_ticket opt ON s.order_product_ticket = opt.id
    JOIN eshop.tickets t ON opt.ticket = t.id
    JOIN eshop.orders o ON opt.order = o.id
    WHERE s.id = ANY(p_spot_ids)
    -- Include any state that implies the spot is technically "occupied"
  ),
  impacted_enriched AS (
    -- Safely extract the specific ticket from JSON
    SELECT
      ib.*,
      (
        SELECT item
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(ib.order_data->'tickets') item
        WHERE (item->>'id')::bigint = ib.ticket_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) as ticket_json
    FROM impacted_base ib
  ),
  order_stats AS (
    -- Calculate if whole order is cancelled
    SELECT
      order_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) as affected_ticket_count,
      COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(order_data->'tickets'), 0) as total_ticket_count
    FROM impacted_enriched
    GROUP BY order_id, order_data
  )
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'order_id', ie.order_id,
      -- Extract individual fields as requested
      'email', ie.order_data->>'email',
      'name', ie.order_data->>'name',
      'surname', ie.order_data->>'surname',
      'note', ie.order_data->>'note',

      'ticket_id', ie.ticket_id,
      'ticket_symbol', ie.ticket_symbol,
      'is_fully_cancelled', (os.affected_ticket_count >= os.total_ticket_count AND os.total_ticket_count > 0),
      -- The products array from the JSON (Spot + Extras)
      'products', ie.ticket_json->'products',
      -- Sum the price (safely handle nulls)
      'total_price', (
         SELECT COALESCE(SUM((prod->>'price')::numeric), 0)
         FROM jsonb_array_elements(ie.ticket_json->'products') prod
      )
    )
  )
  INTO v_conflicts
  FROM impacted_enriched ie
  JOIN order_stats os ON ie.order_id = os.order_id;

  -- =======================================================================
  -- 2. PREPARE NEW ORDER ITEMS
  -- =======================================================================
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'spot_id', s.id,
    'spot_title', s.title,
    'product_title', p.title,
    'price', p.price,
    'currency', p.currency_code
  ))
  INTO v_new_order_items
  FROM eshop.spots s
  LEFT JOIN eshop.products p ON s.product = p.id
  WHERE s.id = ANY(p_spot_ids);

  IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT item->>'currency') FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_new_order_items,'[]')) item)>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BLUEPRINT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(sum((item->>'price')::numeric),0),min(item->>'currency') INTO v_total,v_currency FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_new_order_items,'[]')) item;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('key',f.key,'phone_prefixes',public.get_effective_form_data(f.id)->'phone_prefixes',
    'fields',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ff) ORDER BY coalesce(ff."order",0),ff.id)
      FROM public.form_fields ff WHERE ff.form=f.id AND ff.is_required=true
      AND ff.is_hidden=false AND ff.type NOT IN ('ticket','spot','product_type')),'[]'::jsonb))
    INTO v_order_form FROM public.forms f WHERE f.occasion=v_occasion_id AND f.is_open=true
      AND f.blueprint=(SELECT blueprint FROM eshop.spots WHERE id=p_spot_ids[1])
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eshop.spots WHERE id=ANY(p_spot_ids) AND blueprint IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT blueprint FROM eshop.spots WHERE id=p_spot_ids[1]))
    ORDER BY f.type='ticket' DESC,f.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'conflicts', COALESCE(v_conflicts, '[]'::jsonb),
    'new_order_items', COALESCE(v_new_order_items, '[]'::jsonb),
    'total_price',v_total,'currency',v_currency,'order_form',v_order_form
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_allocations(p_order_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_order_state TEXT;
    v_item_to_allocate RECORD;
    v_existing_spot_count INT;
    v_spots_to_claim INT;
    v_available_spot_id BIGINT;
    v_occasion_id BIGINT;
    v_spots_to_disallocate BIGINT[];
    v_occasion_features JSONB;
    v_is_blueprint_enabled BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    PERFORM public.lock_ticket_order_products_internal(p_order_id);
    -- Initial check for the order's state.
    SELECT state, occasion INTO v_order_state, v_occasion_id
    FROM eshop.orders
    WHERE id = p_order_id;

    SELECT features INTO v_occasion_features FROM public.occasions WHERE id = v_occasion_id;
    v_is_blueprint_enabled := jsonb_path_exists(v_occasion_features, '$[*] ? (@.code == "blueprint" && @.is_enabled == true)');

    -- If the order is not found, raise a structured exception.
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '%', jsonb_build_object('code', 'A001', 'message', 'Order with ID ' || p_order_id || ' not found.')::text;
    END IF;

    -- If the order state is 'storno', disallocate all spots and exit.
    IF v_order_state = 'storno' THEN
        UPDATE eshop.spots
        SET order_product_ticket = NULL, state = NULL, resource = NULL, updated_at = now()
        WHERE order_product_ticket IN (SELECT id FROM eshop.order_product_ticket WHERE "order" = p_order_id);
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- Disallocate spots that are no longer required by the order.
    WITH required_spots AS (
        SELECT opt.id as order_product_ticket_id, pic.inventory_context as inventory_context_id, generate_series(1, pic.quantity)
        FROM eshop.order_product_ticket opt
        JOIN eshop.products p ON opt.product = p.id
        JOIN eshop.product_inventory_contexts pic ON p.id = pic.product
        WHERE opt."order" = p_order_id
    ),
    current_spots AS (
        SELECT s.id, s.order_product_ticket, s.inventory_context
        FROM eshop.spots s
        WHERE s.order_product_ticket IN (SELECT id FROM eshop.order_product_ticket WHERE "order" = p_order_id)
    )
    SELECT array_agg(cs.id)
    INTO v_spots_to_disallocate
    FROM current_spots cs
    LEFT JOIN required_spots rs ON cs.order_product_ticket = rs.order_product_ticket_id AND cs.inventory_context = rs.inventory_context_id
    JOIN eshop.order_product_ticket opt ON cs.order_product_ticket = opt.id
    JOIN eshop.products p ON opt.product = p.id
    JOIN eshop.product_types pt ON p.product_type = pt.id
    WHERE rs.order_product_ticket_id IS NULL
      AND NOT (v_is_blueprint_enabled AND pt.type = 'spot');

    IF v_spots_to_disallocate IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_spots_to_disallocate, 1) > 0 THEN
        UPDATE eshop.spots
        SET order_product_ticket = NULL, state = NULL, resource = NULL, updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = ANY(v_spots_to_disallocate);
    END IF;

    -- Loop through each product in the order that requires an inventory spot to allocate new spots.
    FOR v_item_to_allocate IN
        SELECT
            opt.id AS order_product_ticket_id,
            opt.product AS product_id,
            pic.inventory_context AS inventory_context_id,
            pic.quantity AS required_quantity
        FROM eshop.orders o
        JOIN eshop.order_product_ticket opt ON o.id = opt."order"
        JOIN eshop.products p ON opt.product = p.id
        JOIN eshop.product_inventory_contexts pic ON p.id = pic.product
        WHERE o.id = p_order_id
    LOOP
        -- Check for existing spots for this specific order item AND inventory context.
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO v_existing_spot_count
        FROM eshop.spots s
        WHERE s.order_product_ticket = v_item_to_allocate.order_product_ticket_id
          AND s.inventory_context = v_item_to_allocate.inventory_context_id;

        -- Calculate exactly how many spots are missing.
        v_spots_to_claim := v_item_to_allocate.required_quantity - v_existing_spot_count;

        IF v_spots_to_claim <= 0 THEN
            CONTINUE;
        END IF;

        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_contexts ic JOIN public.inventory_pools ip ON ip.id=ic.inventory_pool
          WHERE ic.id=v_item_to_allocate.inventory_context_id AND ip.sellable_capacity IS NOT NULL AND
          (SELECT count(*) FROM eshop.spots s WHERE s.inventory_context=ic.id AND (s.order_product_ticket IS NOT NULL OR
            (s.secret IS NOT NULL AND s.secret_expiration_time>clock_timestamp())))+v_spots_to_claim>ip.sellable_capacity) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION '%',jsonb_build_object('code',1017,'errorCode','PRODUCT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED','productId',v_item_to_allocate.product_id)::text;
        END IF;
        -- This loop runs precisely the number of times needed to claim the required spots.
        FOR i IN 1..v_spots_to_claim LOOP
            v_available_spot_id := NULL;

            -- Find an available spot. A spot is available only if it's unassigned.
            WITH available_spot_cte AS (
                SELECT s.id
                FROM eshop.spots s
                WHERE s.inventory_context = v_item_to_allocate.inventory_context_id
                  AND s.order_product_ticket IS NULL
                  AND (s.secret IS NULL OR s.secret_expiration_time IS NULL OR s.secret_expiration_time<=clock_timestamp())
                LIMIT 1
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            SELECT id INTO v_available_spot_id FROM available_spot_cte;

            -- If no available spot is found, we must fail with a structured error.
            IF v_available_spot_id IS NULL THEN
                 DECLARE
                    product_data RECORD;
                 BEGIN
                    -- Fetch the details of the product that could not be allocated.
                    SELECT
                        p.id,
                        p.title,
                        p.description,
                        p.price,
                        pt.type,
                        pt.title as type_title,
                        p.currency_code
                    INTO product_data
                    FROM eshop.products p
                    LEFT JOIN eshop.product_types pt ON p.product_type = pt.id
                    WHERE p.id = v_item_to_allocate.product_id;

                    -- Raise the specific overbooked exception with product details.
                    RAISE EXCEPTION '%', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                        'code', 1017,
                        'message', 'Product is overbooked',
                        'product', jsonb_strip_nulls(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                            'id', product_data.id,
                            'title', product_data.title,
                            'description', product_data.description,
                            'price', product_data.price,
                            'type', product_data.type,
                            'type_title', product_data.type_title,
                            'currency_code', product_data.currency_code
                        ))
                    )::TEXT;
                 END;
            END IF;

            -- Claim the found spot.
            UPDATE eshop.spots
            SET
                order_product_ticket = v_item_to_allocate.order_product_ticket_id,
                occasion = v_occasion_id,
                state = 'ordered',
                secret = NULL,
                secret_expiration_time = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = v_available_spot_id;

            -- After claiming the spot, check if it should be automatically assigned to a resource.
            DECLARE
                v_is_auto_assign BOOLEAN;
            BEGIN
                -- Get the auto-assignment setting from the pool associated with the context.
                SELECT (ip.data->>'is_auto_resource_assignment')::boolean
                INTO v_is_auto_assign
                FROM public.inventory_contexts ic
                JOIN public.inventory_pools ip ON ic.inventory_pool = ip.id
                WHERE ic.id = v_item_to_allocate.inventory_context_id;

                -- If auto-assignment is enabled for this pool, call the assignment function.
                IF v_is_auto_assign IS TRUE THEN
                    PERFORM assign_spot_to_resource(v_available_spot_id, v_item_to_allocate.inventory_context_id);
                END IF;
            END;

        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_planned_changes_obsolete_v1()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    change RECORD;
BEGIN
    -- Security Check
    IF auth.role() <> 'service_role' AND session_user <> 'postgres' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access Denied: Service role required.';
    END IF;

    FOR change IN
        SELECT *
        FROM eshop.planned_changes
        WHERE change_time <= NOW() AND applied = FALSE
        ORDER BY change_time ASC
    LOOP
        IF change.change_type = 'products.price' THEN
            -- Update product price
            UPDATE eshop.products
            SET price = change.new_value::NUMERIC
            WHERE id = change.subject_id;

        ELSIF change.change_type = 'products.is_hidden' THEN
            -- Update product visibility
            UPDATE eshop.products
            SET is_hidden = change.new_value::BOOLEAN
            WHERE id = change.subject_id;

        ELSIF change.change_type = 'forms.is_open' THEN
            -- Update form open state
            UPDATE public.forms
            SET is_open = change.new_value::BOOLEAN
            WHERE id = change.subject_id;

        ELSE
            RAISE NOTICE 'Unknown change_type: %', change.change_type;
        END IF;

        -- Mark the change as applied
        UPDATE eshop.planned_changes
        SET applied = TRUE
        WHERE id = change.id;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_group_place_owner_internal_v1(p_occasion bigint, p_group bigint, p_place bigint, p_removing boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.places p WHERE p.id=p_place AND p.occasion=p_occasion AND p.type='group' AND p.is_hidden FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_group_info WHERE place=p_place)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_group_info WHERE id=p_group AND occasion=p_occasion AND place=p_place)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_assignment_places WHERE place_id=p_place)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_places WHERE place_id=p_place)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.events WHERE place=p_place)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.resources WHERE place=p_place)
 OR (p_removing AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cleaning_reports WHERE place=p_place) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cleaning_public_state WHERE place=p_place))) THEN
 RAISE invalid_parameter_value USING MESSAGE='private group place has ambiguous or external ownership'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_spot_to_resource(p_spot_id bigint, p_inventory_context_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_pool_id BIGINT;
    v_resource_id BIGINT;
    v_is_spot_assigned BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Check if the spot is already assigned to prevent overwriting.
    SELECT resource IS NOT NULL INTO v_is_spot_assigned
    FROM eshop.spots
    WHERE id = p_spot_id;

    IF v_is_spot_assigned THEN
        RETURN; -- Spot already has a resource, so we do nothing.
    END IF;

    -- 2. Get the parent inventory_pool from the given context.
    SELECT inventory_pool INTO v_pool_id
    FROM public.inventory_contexts
    WHERE id = p_inventory_context_id;

    -- If the context or pool doesn't exist, we can't proceed.
    IF v_pool_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- 3. Find the first available resource within the pool for the given context.
    --    A resource is "available" if its count of assigned spots is less than its capacity.
    SELECT res.id INTO v_resource_id
    FROM public.resources res
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- Subquery to count assigned spots per resource for this specific context
        SELECT resource as resource_id, COUNT(*) as assigned_spots
        FROM eshop.spots
        WHERE inventory_context = p_inventory_context_id AND resource IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY resource_id
    ) spot_counts ON res.id = spot_counts.resource_id
    WHERE res.inventory_pool = v_pool_id
    -- Check if the resource's capacity is not yet filled
    AND (spot_counts.assigned_spots IS NULL OR spot_counts.assigned_spots < res.capacity)
    ORDER BY res.id -- Order consistently to always pick the "first" available one
    LIMIT 1;

    -- 4. If an available resource was found, update the spot to link it.
    IF v_resource_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE eshop.spots
        SET resource = v_resource_id,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_spot_id;
    END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attach_event_live_projection_v1(p_commit_id uuid, p_occasion bigint, p_event_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_revision bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_commit_id IS NULL OR p_occasion IS NULL OR p_event_ids IS NULL
     OR cardinality(p_event_ids)=0 OR array_position(p_event_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.client_commits c
                    WHERE c.commit_id=p_commit_id AND c.occasion=p_occasion) THEN
    RAISE invalid_parameter_value USING MESSAGE='invalid event live projection attachment';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.client_commit_components c
             WHERE c.commit_id=p_commit_id AND c.component='live_public'
               AND c.scope_type='occasion' AND c.scope_id=p_occasion) THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.client_sync_scopes(component,scope_type,scope_id,source_revision)
  VALUES ('live_public','occasion',p_occasion,1)
  ON CONFLICT (component,scope_type,scope_id) DO UPDATE
    SET source_revision=public.client_sync_scopes.source_revision+1,updated_at=now()
  RETURNING source_revision INTO v_revision;
  INSERT INTO public.client_commit_components
    (commit_id,component,scope_type,scope_id,user_id,resulting_revision)
  VALUES (p_commit_id,'live_public','occasion',p_occasion,NULL,v_revision);
  INSERT INTO public.client_projection_dirty_keys
    (component,scope_type,scope_id,entity_id,source_revision)
  SELECT 'live_public','occasion',p_occasion,id,v_revision
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(p_event_ids) id) ids
  ON CONFLICT (component,scope_type,scope_id,entity_id) DO UPDATE
    SET source_revision=GREATEST(public.client_projection_dirty_keys.source_revision,
        EXCLUDED.source_revision),dirty_since=now(),claimed_at=NULL,claim_token=NULL;
  PERFORM public.refresh_event_public_state_internal_v1(p_occasion,p_event_ids);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bank_sync_accounts_match(p_transaction_id bigint, p_target_account bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM eshop.transactions t
    JOIN eshop.bank_transaction_identities i ON i.transaction_id=t.id AND i.identity_kind='movement'
    JOIN eshop.bank_sync_connections c ON c.instance_id=i.instance_id AND c.provider=i.provider
      AND c.physical_account=i.physical_account AND c.bank_account_id=t.bank_account_id
    WHERE t.id=p_transaction_id AND t.ingest_source='banksync_api' AND c.legacy_blocked_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (p_target_account=c.bank_account_id OR p_target_account IN
        (SELECT bank_account_id FROM eshop.bank_sync_account_aliases WHERE connection_id=c.id))
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bank_sync_existing_facts_match(p_tx eshop.transactions, p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_shift interval:=interval '0'; v_offset integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_tx.ingest_source IN ('legacy','legacy_api','fio_api')
    AND p_data->>'date_offset_min' ~ '^-?[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN
    v_offset:=(p_data->>'date_offset_min')::integer;
    IF abs(v_offset)<=840 THEN v_shift:=make_interval(mins=>v_offset); END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN p_tx.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (p_data->>'amount_cents')::numeric/100
    AND trim(p_tx.currency) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_data->>'currency'
    AND (p_tx.date+v_shift)::date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
      (((p_data->>'date')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')+v_shift)::date
    AND nullif(trim(p_tx.vs),'') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM nullif(p_data->>'raw_vs','')
    AND (p_tx.payer_reference IS NULL OR p_tx.payer_reference IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_data->>'payer_reference');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bank_sync_problem(p_connection_id bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN c.state='suspended' THEN 'suspended'
    WHEN c.state IN ('provisioning','shadow') THEN 'not_configured'
    WHEN c.mode='email' AND c.pairing_code IS NULL THEN 'email_missing'
    WHEN c.mode='api' AND h.token_present IS FALSE THEN 'token_missing'
    WHEN h.ingest_enabled IS FALSE OR (c.mode='api' AND h.polling_enabled IS FALSE) THEN 'bank_error'
    WHEN c.last_error IS NOT NULL OR c.state='degraded' THEN 'bank_error'
    -- bank_pull_at is a local copy of BankSync's successful pull timestamp.
    -- Only a fresh remote health observation can prove that polling stalled;
    -- an unmonitored or expired snapshot is not evidence of a bank failure.
    WHEN c.mode='api' AND h.checked_at>now()-interval '10 minutes'
      AND COALESCE(c.bank_pull_at,c.created_at)<now()-interval '30 minutes' THEN 'stale'
    ELSE NULL END
  FROM eshop.bank_sync_connections c LEFT JOIN eshop.bank_sync_health h ON h.connection_id=c.id
  WHERE c.id=p_connection_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bank_sync_provider_for_account(p_account_number text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT upper(regexp_replace(p_account_number, '\s', '', 'g')) AS account
  ), bank AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN account ~ '^CZ[0-9]{22}$' THEN substring(account,5,4)
      ELSE substring(account FROM '/([0-9]{4})$') END AS code FROM normalized
  )
  SELECT CASE code
    WHEN '2010' THEN 'FIO' WHEN '3030' THEN 'AIRBANK'
    WHEN '0300' THEN 'CSOB' WHEN '0600' THEN 'MONETA'
    WHEN '2250' THEN 'CREDITAS' WHEN '5500' THEN 'RAIFFEISENBANK'
    WHEN '2700' THEN 'UNICREDIT' WHEN '0800' THEN 'CSAS'
  END FROM bank;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_declared_font_families_internal(p_layout jsonb, p_presets boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(font_family_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE documents(doc) AS (
  SELECT p_layout UNION ALL
  SELECT preset->'document' FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(doc->'presets','[]')) preset WHERE p_presets
 ), styles(style) AS (
  SELECT doc->'styles' FROM documents
  UNION ALL SELECT kind_style.value FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(coalesce(doc#>'{styles,kinds}','{}')) kind_style
  UNION ALL SELECT node->'style' FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(doc->'nodes') node
  UNION ALL SELECT child_style.value FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(doc->'nodes') node
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(coalesce(node->'childStyles','{}')) child_style
 ) SELECT DISTINCT style#>>'{label,fontFamilyId}' FROM styles WHERE style#>>'{label,fontFamilyId}' IS NOT NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_grid_cell_filled_internal(p_surface jsonb, p_x numeric, p_y numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(p_surface->>'type'='grid'
  AND public.blueprint_grid_contains_internal(p_surface->'outer',p_x+0.5,p_y+0.5)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_surface->'holes') hole WHERE public.blueprint_grid_contains_internal(hole,p_x+0.5,p_y+0.5)),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_layout_asset_refs_internal(p_layout jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(asset_ref text, hash text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE documents(doc) AS (SELECT p_layout UNION ALL SELECT preset->'document' FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(doc->'presets','[]')) preset)
 SELECT doc#>>'{background,assetRef}',doc#>>'{background,hash}' FROM documents WHERE doc#>>'{background,assetRef}' IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT node#>>'{graphic,assetRef}',node#>>'{graphic,hash}' FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(doc->'nodes','[]')) node WHERE node->>'kind'='image'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_layout_resources_internal(p_layout jsonb, p_occasion bigint, p_unit bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_layout->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '2' THEN RAISE check_violation USING MESSAGE='BLUEPRINT_LAYOUT_MIGRATION_REQUIRED';END IF;
 RETURN public.blueprint_canonical_text_resources_internal(p_layout,p_occasion,NULL,true)||jsonb_build_object('assets',public.blueprint_canonical_asset_resources_internal(p_layout,p_occasion,p_unit));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_layout_text_requests_internal(p_layout jsonb, p_presets boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(node_key text, font_family_id text, font_face_id text, role text, descriptor jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE documents(doc,prefix) AS (
  SELECT p_layout,''::text UNION ALL
  SELECT preset->'document',prefix||(preset->>'id')||'/' FROM documents
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(doc->'presets','[]')) preset WHERE p_presets
 ), roles AS (
  SELECT doc,prefix||(node->>'id') AS node_key,node,
   public.blueprint_resolved_label_internal(doc,node) AS label,
   CASE WHEN node->>'kind'='text' THEN 'text' ELSE 'label' END AS role,
   CASE WHEN node->>'kind'='text' THEN coalesce(node->>'text','') ELSE coalesce(node->>'label','') END AS source
  FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(doc->'nodes') node
  WHERE node->>'kind' NOT IN ('group','seat','vector','image')
   AND (node->>'kind'<>'furniture' OR node->>'furniture' IS DISTINCT FROM 'couch')
   AND (node->>'kind'<>'table' OR node->>'furniture' IS DISTINCT FROM 'bar')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT doc,prefix||(node->>'id')||':number',node,
   (public.blueprint_contract_metadata_internal()->'labelDefaults')||(doc->'textPolicy')||coalesce(doc#>'{styles,label}','{}'),
   'number','' FROM documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(doc->'nodes') node
  WHERE node->>'kind'='capacityArea' OR (node->>'kind'='furniture' AND node->>'furniture' IS DISTINCT FROM 'couch' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(doc->'selectionUnits','[]')) unit WHERE jsonb_array_length(unit->'nodeIds')>1
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(unit->'nodeIds') member
     WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(doc->'nodes') child WHERE child->>'id'=member AND child->>'parentId'=node->>'id'))))
 ), requests AS (
  SELECT roles.*,f.manifest->'faces'->>((label->>'weight')||':'||CASE WHEN label->>'italic'='true' THEN 'italic' ELSE 'normal' END) AS face_id
   FROM roles LEFT JOIN public.ticket_font_families f ON f.id=label->>'fontFamilyId'
 )
 SELECT node_key,label->>'fontFamilyId',face_id,role,
  CASE WHEN role='number' THEN jsonb_build_object('layoutResourceProtocol',2,'policy',public.blueprint_contract_metadata_internal()->'textPolicy','role','number','fontFaceId',face_id)
  ELSE jsonb_build_object('layoutResourceProtocol',2,'policy',public.blueprint_contract_metadata_internal()->'textPolicy',
   'request',jsonb_build_object('text',source,'role',role,'fontFamilyId',label->>'fontFamilyId','fontFaceId',face_id,
    'size',label->'size','language',label->'language','direction',label->'direction','lineHeight',label->'lineHeight','align',label->'align',
    'box',jsonb_build_object('x',-(node->>'width')::numeric/2,'y',-(node->>'height')::numeric/2,'width',node->'width','height',node->'height'),
    'fit',CASE WHEN role='text' THEN 'wrap' ELSE 'shrink' END)) END
 FROM requests WHERE role='number' OR source<>''
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_legacy_migration_source_internal(p_blueprint bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'organization',b.organization,'occasion',b.occasion,'title',b.title,'configuration',b.configuration,'objects',b.objects,'groups',b.groups,'background_svg',b.background_svg,'occasionMeta',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'organization',o.organization,'unit',o.unit,'end_time',o.end_time,'is_hidden',o.is_hidden,'is_open',o.is_open,'occasion_hidden',o.occasion_hidden) FROM public.occasions o WHERE o.id=b.occasion),'forms',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f.id,'occasion',f.occasion,'is_open',f.is_open,'type',f.type) ORDER BY f.id) FROM public.forms f WHERE f.blueprint=b.id),'[]'),'spots',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'occasion',s.occasion,'title',s.title,'product',s.product,'state',s.state,'inventory_context',s.inventory_context,'resource',s.resource,'resource_slot',s.resource_slot) ORDER BY s.id) FROM eshop.spots s WHERE s.blueprint=b.id),'[]'),'products',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'occasion',p.occasion,'product_type',p.product_type,'title',p.title,'price',p.price,'currency_code',p.currency_code) ORDER BY p.id) FROM eshop.products p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT s.product FROM eshop.spots s WHERE s.blueprint=b.id)),'[]')) FROM eshop.blueprints b WHERE b.id=p_blueprint;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_public_binding_projection_internal(p_blueprint bigint, p_secret uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT public.blueprint_binding_projection_internal(p_blueprint)||jsonb_build_object('seatBindings',coalesce(
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('nodeId',b.node_id,'spotId',b.spot,'productId',s.product,'title',s.title,'selectionUnitId',b.selection_unit,'groupNodeId',b.group_node,'blocked',b.blocked,'productAssignmentMode',b.product_assignment_mode,'status',CASE
 WHEN b.blocked OR s.product IS NULL THEN 'unavailable' WHEN s.order_product_ticket IS NOT NULL THEN 'ordered'
 WHEN s.secret IS NOT NULL AND s.secret_expiration_time>statement_timestamp() THEN CASE WHEN s.secret=p_secret THEN 'selected_by_me' ELSE 'selected' END
 ELSE 'available' END) ORDER BY b.node_id) FROM eshop.blueprint_seat_bindings b JOIN eshop.spots s ON s.id=b.spot WHERE b.blueprint=p_blueprint),'[]'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_public_document_internal(p_layout jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_set(jsonb_set(p_layout,'{presets}','[]'),'{nodes}',
  coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(node-'originalSource' ORDER BY position)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_layout->'nodes') WITH ORDINALITY records(node,position)),'[]'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_resolved_label_internal(p_doc jsonb, p_node jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT (public.blueprint_contract_metadata_internal()->'labelDefaults')
  ||jsonb_build_object('align',CASE WHEN p_node->>'kind'='text' THEN 'left' ELSE 'center' END)
  ||(p_doc->'textPolicy')||coalesce(p_doc#>'{styles,label}','{}')
  ||coalesce(p_doc->'styles'->'kinds'->(p_node->>'kind')->'label','{}')
  ||coalesce((SELECT parent#>'{childStyles,seat,label}' FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_doc->'nodes') parent
    WHERE p_node->>'kind'='seat' AND parent->>'kind'='table' AND parent->>'id'=p_node->>'parentId'),'{}')
  ||coalesce(p_node#>'{style,label}','{}')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_selection_unit_spots_internal(p_spot bigint)
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(member.spot ORDER BY member.spot),ARRAY[p_spot])
 FROM eshop.blueprint_seat_bindings selected JOIN eshop.blueprint_seat_bindings member
 ON member.blueprint=selected.blueprint AND member.selection_unit=selected.selection_unit
 WHERE selected.spot=p_spot AND selected.selection_unit IS NOT NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.blueprint_text_resource_ids_internal(p_layout jsonb, p_occasion bigint, p_setup_draft uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT r.resource_id ORDER BY r.resource_id),'{}'::text[])
 FROM public.blueprint_text_resources r JOIN public.blueprint_layout_text_requests_internal(p_layout,true) q
  ON r.payload->'descriptor' @> q.descriptor AND r.payload->'descriptor'=q.descriptor
 WHERE r.scope_key=CASE WHEN p_occasion IS NOT NULL THEN 'occasion:'||p_occasion::text ELSE 'setup:'||p_setup_draft::text END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_order_email_intents(p_order bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_user NOT IN ('postgres','service_role') THEN PERFORM public.require_service_role(); END IF;
 UPDATE public.email_messages SET workflow_state='cancelled',last_error='payment_changed',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL
 WHERE order_id=p_order AND message_kind IN ('order_payment_notice','order_tickets','order_reminder') AND workflow_state IN ('pending','retry_wait','blocked','preparing');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_copy_occasion_source(p_occasion bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN public.is_demo_occasion(p_occasion)
  THEN public.can_read_demo_occasion(p_occasion)
  ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.occasions o WHERE o.id=p_occasion
    AND public.get_is_manager_on_unit(o.unit)) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_edit_ticket_layout(p_occasion bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE((SELECT public.get_is_editor_on_unit(o.unit)
    FROM public.occasions o WHERE o.id=p_occasion),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_demo_occasion(p_occasion bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_occasions d JOIN public.user_info u
   ON u.organization=d.organization AND u.id=auth.uid()
  WHERE d.occasion=p_occasion AND d.is_listed);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_group_data_security_v1(p_group bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM public.user_group_info g WHERE g.id=p_group AND (
   public.get_is_editor_view_on_occasion(g.occasion) OR EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public.user_groups ug WHERE ug."group"=g.id AND ug."user"=auth.uid())));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_news_data_security_v1(p_occasion bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.occasions o WHERE o.id=p_occasion AND (

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_scan_password_reset_target_allowed(p_target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_target_user_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.organization_users org_u
         WHERE org_u."user" = p_target_user_id
           AND org_u.is_admin IS TRUE
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.unit_users uu
         WHERE uu."user" = p_target_user_id
           AND (
               uu.is_manager IS TRUE
               OR uu.is_editor IS TRUE
               OR uu.is_editor_view IS TRUE
           )
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.occasion_users ou
         WHERE ou."user" = p_target_user_id
           AND (
               ou.is_manager IS TRUE
               OR ou.is_editor IS TRUE
               OR ou.is_editor_view IS TRUE
               OR ou.is_editor_order IS TRUE
               OR ou.is_editor_order_view IS TRUE
               OR ou.is_approver IS TRUE
               OR coalesce(
                   (to_jsonb(ou)->>'is_cleaning_crew')::boolean,
                   false
               )
               OR coalesce(
                   (to_jsonb(ou)->>'is_receptionist')::boolean,
                   false
               )
           )
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM public.user_groups ug
         WHERE ug."user" = p_target_user_id
           AND ug.is_admin IS TRUE
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Privileged users cannot have their password reset via scan.'
          USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_client_projection_dirty_internal_v1(p_scope_ids bigint[], p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(component text, scope_type text, scope_id bigint, entity_id bigint, source_revision bigint, claim_token uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.require_client_sync_service_role_v1();
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT d.component, d.scope_type, d.scope_id, d.entity_id
    FROM public.client_projection_dirty_keys d
    JOIN public.occasions o
      ON d.scope_type = 'occasion'
     AND o.id = d.scope_id
     AND NOT o.is_hidden
    WHERE (p_scope_ids IS NULL OR d.scope_id = ANY(p_scope_ids))
      AND (d.claimed_at IS NULL
        OR d.claimed_at < now() - interval '2 minutes')
    ORDER BY d.dirty_since
    FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT LEAST(p_limit, 1000)
  ), updated AS (
    UPDATE public.client_projection_dirty_keys d
    SET claimed_at = now(), claim_token = gen_random_uuid()
    FROM claimed c
    WHERE (d.component, d.scope_type, d.scope_id, d.entity_id) =
          (c.component, c.scope_type, c.scope_id, c.entity_id)
    RETURNING d.*
  )
  SELECT u.component, u.scope_type, u.scope_id, u.entity_id,
         u.source_revision, u.claim_token
  FROM updated u;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compact_client_mutation_receipts_v1(p_cutoff timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count bigint; v_bytes bigint;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.require_client_sync_service_role_v1();
  IF p_cutoff IS NULL OR p_cutoff>now()-interval '30 days'
     OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 THEN
    RAISE invalid_parameter_value USING MESSAGE='invalid receipt compaction boundary';
  END IF;
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT r.command_id,octet_length(r.response::text) response_bytes
    FROM public.client_mutation_receipts r
    WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.completed_at<p_cutoff
    ORDER BY r.completed_at,r.command_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT p_limit
  ), updated AS (
    UPDATE public.client_mutation_receipts r
    SET status='expired',response=NULL,expired_at=clock_timestamp()
    FROM candidates c WHERE r.command_id=c.command_id
    RETURNING c.response_bytes
  ) SELECT count(*),COALESCE(sum(response_bytes),0) INTO v_count,v_bytes FROM updated;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('compacted',v_count,'responseBytesReleasedEstimate',v_bytes);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_client_mutation_outcome_v1(p_command_id uuid, p_status text, p_code integer, p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_response jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_status NOT IN ('unchanged','rejected','conflict')
    OR p_code NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 599 OR p_data IS NULL
    OR octet_length(p_data::text)>4194304 THEN
    RAISE invalid_parameter_value USING MESSAGE='invalid mutation outcome';
  END IF;
  v_response:=jsonb_build_object('status',p_status,'code',p_code,'data',p_data,
    'mutation',jsonb_build_object('commandId',p_command_id,'receiptId',p_command_id,
      'commitId',NULL,'replayed',false,'occurredAt',clock_timestamp()),
    'sync',jsonb_build_object('replacements','[]'::jsonb));
  RETURN public.finish_client_mutation_v1(p_command_id,v_response,NULL);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_private_inventory_mutation_v1(p_command_id uuid, p_occasion bigint, p_source text, p_items jsonb, p_impacted_users uuid[], p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_impacts jsonb; v_replacements jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('component','private_inventory',
    'userId',u.id) ORDER BY u.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_impacts
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_impacted_users,'{}')) id) u
  JOIN public.occasion_users ou ON ou.occasion=p_occasion AND ou."user"=u.id;
  IF v_actor IS NOT NULL AND v_actor=ANY(COALESCE(p_impacted_users,'{}'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.occasion_users ou
      WHERE ou.occasion=p_occasion AND ou."user"=v_actor) THEN
    v_replacements:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'component','private_inventory','userId',v_actor,
      'payload',public.get_user_inventory_for_occasion_v1(p_occasion)));
  END IF;
  RETURN public.complete_client_mutation_applied_v1(p_command_id,p_occasion,
    p_source,'inventory',p_items,'{}',v_impacts,'[]',p_data,
    '{}','[]','user',NULL,v_replacements);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_private_profile_mutation_v1(p_command_id uuid, p_occasion bigint, p_source text, p_items jsonb, p_impacted_users uuid[], p_public_components text[], p_dirty_keys jsonb, p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_impacts jsonb; v_replacements jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.client_aggregate_versions
    (aggregate_type,scope_type,scope_id,aggregate_id,version)
  SELECT 'occasion_user','occasion',p_occasion,u.id::text,1
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_impacted_users,'{}')) id) u
  JOIN public.occasion_users ou ON ou.occasion=p_occasion AND ou."user"=u.id
  ON CONFLICT (aggregate_type,scope_type,scope_id,aggregate_id) DO UPDATE
    SET version=public.client_aggregate_versions.version+1,
      updated_at=clock_timestamp();
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('component','private_profile',
    'userId',u.id) ORDER BY u.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_impacts
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_impacted_users,'{}')) id) u
  JOIN public.occasion_users ou ON ou.occasion=p_occasion AND ou."user"=u.id;
  IF v_actor IS NOT NULL AND v_actor=ANY(COALESCE(p_impacted_users,'{}'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.occasion_users ou
      WHERE ou.occasion=p_occasion AND ou."user"=v_actor) THEN
    v_replacements:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'component','private_profile','userId',v_actor,
      'payload',public.get_private_profile_payload_v1(p_occasion,v_actor)));
  END IF;
  RETURN public.complete_client_mutation_applied_v1(p_command_id,p_occasion,
    p_source,'profile',p_items,p_public_components,v_impacts,p_dirty_keys,p_data,
    '{}','[]','user',NULL,v_replacements);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.configure_first_login_notifications_v1(p_organization bigint, p_recipient text, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.require_service_role();
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended('festapp-first-login-notifications',0));
  -- Never send a historical flood when enabling a tenant. Existing users with no
  -- successful login remain eligible for their first real login after activation.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.first_login_notification_settings WHERE organization=p_organization) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.first_login_notifications(user_id,organization,baseline)
    SELECT ui.id,ui.organization,true FROM public.user_info ui JOIN auth.users au ON au.id=ui.id
    WHERE ui.organization=p_organization AND au.last_sign_in_at IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.first_login_notification_settings(organization,recipient,enabled)
  VALUES(p_organization,lower(btrim(p_recipient)),p_enabled)
  ON CONFLICT(organization) DO UPDATE SET recipient=excluded.recipient,enabled=excluded.enabled;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.copy_occasion_title_internal(p_title text, p_locale text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE suffix text; base text := coalesce(p_title,'');
BEGIN
 suffix := CASE split_part(replace(lower(coalesce(p_locale,'en')),'_','-'),'-',1)
  WHEN 'cs' THEN 'kopie' WHEN 'sk' THEN 'kópia' WHEN 'de' THEN 'kopie'
  WHEN 'pl' THEN 'kopia' WHEN 'uk' THEN 'копія' ELSE 'copy' END;
 base := regexp_replace(base, '(\s*\((copy|kopie|kópia|kopia|копія)\))+$', '', 'i');
 RETURN left(rtrim(base),500-length(suffix)-3) || ' (' || suffix || ')';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.copy_product_type_with_products(p_source_product_type_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_new_product_type_id BIGINT;
    v_source_product_type_exists BOOLEAN;
    v_new_product_type_title TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Check if the source product_type exists
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eshop.product_types WHERE id = p_source_product_type_id) INTO v_source_product_type_exists;
    IF NOT v_source_product_type_exists THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source product_type with ID % does not exist.', p_source_product_type_id;
    END IF;

    -- Create a slightly modified title for the copy
    SELECT title || ' (Copy ' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ')' INTO v_new_product_type_title
    FROM eshop.product_types
    WHERE id = p_source_product_type_id;

    -- 1. Create a copy of the product_type record
    INSERT INTO eshop.product_types (
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        title, -- use the modified title
        description,
        type,
        data,
        occasion,
        maximum
    )
    SELECT
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        v_new_product_type_title, -- Use the new title
        pt.description,
        pt.type,
        pt.data,
        pt.occasion, -- Copied product type will belong to the same occasion
        pt.maximum
    FROM eshop.product_types pt
    WHERE pt.id = p_source_product_type_id
    RETURNING id INTO v_new_product_type_id;

    -- 2. Copy all associated products, linking them to the new product_type
    INSERT INTO eshop.products (
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        title,
        description,
        price,
        data,
        product_type, -- This will be the ID of the new product_type
        occasion,
        is_hidden,
        currency_code,
        title_short,
        "order",
        maximum
    )
    SELECT
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        p.title, -- Product titles are copied as is
        p.description,
        p.price,
        p.data,
        v_new_product_type_id,  -- Link to the newly created product_type
        p.occasion, -- Copied products will belong to the same occasion as original products
        p.is_hidden,
        p.currency_code,
        p.title_short,
        p."order",
        p.maximum
    FROM eshop.products p
    WHERE p.product_type = p_source_product_type_id;

    RETURN v_new_product_type_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_service_item_internal_v1(oc bigint, type text, code text, title text, reference bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  existing_codes JSONB;
  new_service_item JSONB;
BEGIN

  IF (SELECT get_is_manager_on_occasion(oc)) <> TRUE THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 403);
  END IF;

  -- Check if the code already exists within the specified type
  SELECT jsonb_agg(item)
  INTO existing_codes
  FROM public.occasions,
       jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(occasions.services->type, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item
  WHERE occasions.id = oc
    AND (item->>'code') = code;

  IF existing_codes IS NOT NULL THEN
    -- If code exists, return an error response
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 400,
      'message', 'Code must be unique within the specified type'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Build the new service item JSON
  new_service_item := jsonb_build_object(
    'code', code,
    'title', title,
    'reference', reference
  );

  -- Update the occasion to add the new item to the specified type array in services.
  -- Guard against `services` being SQL NULL *or* a JSON scalar/`null` (which
  -- COALESCE does not catch and which makes jsonb_set raise
  -- "cannot set path in scalar"). Same guard for the per-type array.
  UPDATE public.occasions
  SET services = jsonb_set(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(services) = 'object' THEN services ELSE '{}'::jsonb END,
    ARRAY[type],
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(services->type) = 'array' THEN services->type ELSE '[]'::jsonb END || new_service_item,
    true
  )
  WHERE id = oc;

  -- Return success response
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'code', 200,
    'message', 'Service item created successfully'
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_order_answers_internal(p_form bigint, p_data jsonb, p_ticket boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title',f.title,'type',f.type,'value',CASE WHEN f.type='id_document' AND jsonb_typeof(answer.value)='object'
  THEN jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('id_document_number',answer.value->'id_document_number',
   'id_document_expiry_date',answer.value->'id_document_expiry_date')) ELSE answer.value END) ORDER BY f."order",f.id),'[]')
 FROM public.form_fields f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT coalesce(a->(f.id::text),a->f.type) value
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_data->'fields')='array' THEN p_data->'fields' ELSE '[]' END) a
  WHERE a ? f.id::text OR (a->>'_subFieldId'=f.id::text AND a ? f.type)
   OR (NOT a ? '_subFieldId' AND a ? f.type
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(a) k WHERE k ~ '^[0-9]+$')
    AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.form_fields other WHERE other.form=p_form AND other.type=f.type AND other.is_ticket_field=p_ticket AND NOT other.is_hidden))
  LIMIT 1
 ) answer
 WHERE f.form=p_form AND f.is_ticket_field=p_ticket AND NOT f.is_hidden
 AND f.type IN ('name','surname','email','phone','city','sex','birth_year','birth_date','address','nationality','id_document','text','note','select_one','select_many')
 AND ((f.type='id_document' AND jsonb_typeof(answer.value)='object'
  AND jsonb_typeof(answer.value->'id_document_number')='string'
  AND (answer.value->'id_document_expiry_date' IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(answer.value->'id_document_expiry_date') IN ('string','null')))
  OR jsonb_typeof(answer.value) IN ('string','number','boolean') OR (jsonb_typeof(answer.value)='array'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(answer.value)='array' THEN answer.value ELSE '[]' END) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v) NOT IN ('string','number','boolean'))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_order_payment_internal(p_order bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 WITH facts AS (
 SELECT o.*,p.amount,coalesce(p.paid,0) received,coalesce(p.returned,0) returned,
 p.deposit_amount,p.deposit_deadline,p.deadline,p.variable_symbol,p.creditor_reference,
 b.account_number,b.account_number_human_readable,
 coalesce(nullif(trim(b.creditor_name),''),(SELECT left(trim(regexp_replace(org.title,'[[:space:][:cntrl:]]+',' ','g')),70) FROM public.occasions occ JOIN public.organizations org ON org.id=occ.organization WHERE occ.id=o.occasion)) creditor_name,
 CASE WHEN o.state='preparing_payment' THEN 'preparing'
 WHEN o.state='storno' THEN 'cancelled'
 WHEN o.state='waitlisted' AND p.id IS NULL THEN 'not_required_yet'
 WHEN o.price=0 THEN 'free'
 WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.currency_code IS DISTINCT FROM o.currency_code OR p.amount IS NULL OR p.amount<0 OR coalesce(p.paid,0)<0 OR coalesce(p.paid_externally,0)<>0
  OR (o.state IN ('paid','sent') AND o.price>0 AND coalesce(p.paid,0)=0) THEN 'unknown'
 WHEN coalesce(p.paid,0)>=p.amount THEN 'fully_paid'
 WHEN coalesce(p.paid,0)=0 THEN 'unpaid'
 WHEN p.deposit_amount>0 AND p.paid>=p.deposit_amount THEN 'deposit_paid'
 ELSE 'partially_paid' END status
 FROM eshop.orders o LEFT JOIN eshop.payment_info p ON p.id=o.payment_info
 LEFT JOIN eshop.bank_accounts b ON b.id=p.bank_account WHERE o.id=p_order),
 due AS (SELECT *,greatest(amount-received,0) outstanding,
 CASE WHEN deposit_amount>received THEN greatest(deposit_amount-received,0) ELSE greatest(amount-received,0) END due_now,
 CASE WHEN deposit_amount>received THEN deposit_deadline ELSE deadline END due_at FROM facts)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',status,'amount',amount,'received',received,'returned',returned,
 'totalOutstanding',outstanding,'overpaid',greatest(received-amount,0),'depositAmount',deposit_amount,
 'depositDeadline',deposit_deadline,'finalDeadline',deadline,
 'dueNow',CASE WHEN status IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','deposit_paid') THEN due_now ELSE 0 END,
 'dueAt',due_at,'overdue',coalesce(due_at<statement_timestamp() AND due_now>0,false),
 'instructionsAvailable',status IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','deposit_paid') AND account_number IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN currency_code='EUR' THEN creditor_reference IS NOT NULL ELSE variable_symbol IS NOT NULL END,
 'reference',CASE WHEN status IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','deposit_paid') THEN
  CASE WHEN currency_code='EUR' THEN creditor_reference ELSE variable_symbol::text END END,
 'qrPayment',CASE WHEN status IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','deposit_paid') AND due_now>0 AND account_number IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN currency_code='EUR' THEN creditor_reference IS NOT NULL ELSE variable_symbol IS NOT NULL END
 THEN jsonb_build_object('amount',due_now,'currency_code',trim(currency_code),'account_number',account_number,
  'account_number_human_readable',account_number_human_readable,'creditor_name',creditor_name,
  'variable_symbol',variable_symbol,'creditor_reference',creditor_reference) END,
 'referenceKind',CASE WHEN currency_code='EUR' THEN 'RF' ELSE 'VS' END,
 'transactions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'date',t.date::date,'recordedAt',t.created_at,'amount',t.amount,'currency',trim(t.currency),
  'kind',CASE WHEN t.transaction_type='return' THEN 'refund' WHEN t.amount>0 THEN 'payment_received' ELSE 'payment_adjustment' END)
  ORDER BY t.created_at NULLS LAST,t.id),'[]') FROM eshop.transactions t WHERE t.payment_info=due.payment_info),
 'publicAccount',CASE WHEN status IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','deposit_paid') THEN coalesce(account_number_human_readable,account_number) END)
 FROM due;
$function$
